name: agentinbox
description: Read shared IMAP or POP3 mail and send requested messages through optional SMTP.

interface.shortDescription: IMAP or POP3 reading and optional SMTP sending.
interface.longDescription: Choose mail servers and account permissions in local setup. Password is the default; optional Microsoft sign-in requires explicit selection and your app registration. Search shared IMAP or POP3 mail, and send messages when you explicitly ask. AgentInbox has no second confirmation window. POP3 has no unread flags or server folders. Requested mail content can reach your assistant's AI service. This source implementation remains unvalidated.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentInbox to list my shared accounts and find messages from today within each account's supported capabilities.
Which of my AgentInbox accounts have sending enabled?
